description.fun: Archen was long thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, though the latest research suggests that may not be so. Revived from the Plume Fossil, it can't fly: it lived in the treetops, hopping from branch to branch and gliding down to snatch prey, eating berries and Bug-type Pokémon. It's very good at jumping, though. It's based on Archaeopteryx, once thought to be the very first bird.
description.guide: Archen is a Rock- and Flying-type Fossil Pokémon revived from the Plume Fossil and based on Archaeopteryx. It cannot fly but hops between treetops and glides down to catch prey. It evolves into Archeops.
description.tagline: A flightless first bird that hops and glides through the trees.

description.fun: Archeops can fly, but its wing muscles are weak, so it needs a long runway: it sprints at nearly 40 km/h over about 4 km before it can take off. It's better on the ground anyway, running as fast as a car and hunting in clever flocks where one corners the prey and another swoops in. Its plumage is so delicate that only an experienced professional can restore it from a fossil.
description.guide: Archeops is the evolved form of Archen, a Rock- and Flying-type Fossil Pokémon. It can fly but needs a long running start, and it hunts more effectively on the ground, working in groups to catch prey.
description.tagline: An ancient bird that needs a 4 km runway to take off.
